title: A Horizon for the Archive
author: B. M. Yarrow
blurb: Vesper Vane, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
